title: What If We Built a Skyscraper One Kilometer Tall?

scenes.text: What if a skyscraper stood a full kilometer tall? One is being built.
Jeddah Tower is planned to pass 1,000 meters. The Burj Khalifa, the tallest today, is 828 meters.
That makes it about 173 meters taller than anything standing.
The enemy is wind, so engineers used computer modeling and extensive wind tunnel testing.
It plans 59 elevators, including 5 double-deck cars, and the observatory lifts move at 10 meters per second.
Completion is targeted for 2028. Soon, the tallest building on Earth could be a full kilometer.
